intro: AI is the most important change I have seen in my career, and I treat it as a practical discipline. I train people on it, govern it, and use it every day to learn and build. My test is simple: did it solve a real problem, and can a person check the answer?

layers.name: At work, with people
layers.text: I lead AI adoption across the Middle East region. Around 300 employees in multiple departments have been trained on applying Microsoft Copilot and related tools to everyday tasks. I then established an initiative to find high-value use cases and delivered working applications from the findings.

layers.name: On hard technical problems
layers.text: I use AI as a research partner when I reach the edge of what I know. When a production machine lost contact with its application, AI tools helped me find the documentation for an unfamiliar device. I still tested each theory by hand.

layers.name: On automation
layers.text: I use workflow automation to make handoffs accountable: automated policy acknowledgement during a certification, SharePoint approvals with digital signatures, and notifications that keep work visible until it is closed.

layers.name: On governance
layers.text: I am an ISO 42001 Practitioner through the TRECCERT Digital Trust Fellowship. I also keep humans responsible in everything I build: source links, confidence labels, approval steps and clear limits on what a model is allowed to do.

layers.name: As a builder
layers.text: Outside work I direct AI coding agents, including OpenAI Codex and Anthropic's Claude, to build real software. I write the requirements, make the design decisions, review the work and test each release on real devices. I am clear about what this is: product direction and AI-assisted delivery, not a claim to have hand-written the code.

capabilities.name: Practical AI-assisted problem-solving
capabilities.text: Combine AI tools with documentation and hands-on checks to investigate unfamiliar problems.

capabilities.name: Enterprise AI adoption and enablement
capabilities.text: Teach people to apply AI to their own tasks, then keep following up.

capabilities.name: Use-case discovery
capabilities.text: Identify where AI creates value across business functions, and carry the best ideas through to applications.

capabilities.name: AI-assisted product development
capabilities.text: Translate needs into precise instructions, review generated work, test real behaviour and iterate.

capabilities.name: Human-AI collaboration
capabilities.text: Combine human judgement, domain knowledge and acceptance decisions with AI-assisted implementation.

capabilities.name: Intelligent workflow design
capabilities.text: Connect source collection, structured generation, validation, rendering and human review.

capabilities.name: Structured, evidence-aware AI
capabilities.text: Use schemas, source links, confidence labels and validation to make AI output reviewable.

capabilities.name: Agents and multi-model systems
capabilities.level: Directed in practice; designed as a concept
capabilities.text: I direct coding agents day to day. I have also specified a system with specialised agents, counter-analysis and human-controlled decision rules, which is not yet built.

capabilities.name: Automation with accountable handoffs
capabilities.text: Make notifications, acknowledgements, review and closure visible.

capabilities.name: AI visual and interaction direction
capabilities.text: Specify visual behaviour, assess usability and refine creative work over successive versions.

capabilities.name: AI governance
capabilities.text: Apply AI management thinking to adoption, with clear responsibility and limits.
